evidence.title: When Text and Numbers Disagree: Evidence Arbitration in Large Language Models

summary: A new method called evidence arbitration enables LLMs to detect when textual statements clash with numerical data and to reconcile these inconsistencies, boosting factual reliability. Experiments show the technique improves performance on benchmark tasks that involve contradictory information between words and numbers.
title: Researchers Introduce Evidence Arbitration to Reconcile Text‑Numeric Conflicts in Large Language Models
